name: Furious Anger (Gestalt)
body:
You can embrace your rage, ensuring the destruction of your enemies.

Prerequisite: Con 13, character level 3rd, you have no levels in a class that has the rage class feature.

Benefit: You gain the ability to rage like a barbarian. You do not gain any rage powers. You can rage a number of rounds per day equal to your Constitution modifier plus 1 round per two character levels.

Special: If you gain levels in a class that grants the rage class feature, you can immediately trade this feat for the Extra Rage feat.
